title: Preparata and Del Giudice worked with Fleischmann and Pons on cold fusion
summary: Filippo Biondi tells of Preparata and Del Giudice worked with Fleischmann and Pons on cold fusion, about 1980s-2015 at University of Milan, Italy, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Yes, they were the scientists that worked together to Fleischmann and Pons.

plain: Filippo Biondi, a researcher who scans beneath the Egyptian pyramids, told podcast host Jesse Michels that two Italian physicists from the University of Milan, Giuliano Preparata and Emilio Del Giudice, worked alongside Martin Fleischmann and Stanley Pons. Fleischmann and Pons are the two chemists linked to cold fusion, the idea of getting nuclear energy from a tabletop experiment at room temperature. Biondi brings it up to place his own scientific roots in that line of work.
